name: MOISTURE ANALYZER BALANCE
desc: Microprocessor-Controlled High-Precision Digital Moisture Analyzer Balance engineered for rapid and reliable moisture determination. Features a maximum weighing capacity of 200g with an analytical readability of 0.001g, powered by a high-resolution EMFC Monotech sensor.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS MOISTURE ANALYZER BALANCE is a microprocessor-controlled halogen-loss-on-drying (LOD) system built around a high-resolution Electromagnetic Force Compensation (EMFC) weighing cell, delivering 0.001 g mass readability and 0.001% moisture resolution across a 200 g continuous analytical load spectrum. The integrated Smart Radiation Attachment (SRA) halogen reflector applies homogeneous thermal energy from 30°C to 175°C (optionally up to 250°C) under user-defined Standard, Gentle, Rapid, Steps, or High Temperature drying profiles, while real-time EMFC mass tracking quantifies volatilized water and volatile components via thermogravimetric loss-on-drying. In pharmaceutical QC and R&D, doctors, pharmacists, and PhD researchers use the analyzer to validate moisture content in active pharmaceutical ingredients, excipients, granules, and lyophilized powders against USP <731> Loss on Drying and GMP/GLP data-integrity requirements; food and agricultural chemists determine moisture in cereals, dairy powders, spices, and animal feed per AOAC or ISO 287; polymer and materials scientists test resin pellets, masterbatches, biomass, and soil samples under ASTM D6980 to assure batch-to-batch dry solids consistency. B.Sc/M.Sc students and laboratory technicians rely on the instrument for comparative moisture sorption studies, drying-curve generation, and routine quality checks without transferring hot samples to external balances.
sop: Place the analyzer on a stable, vibration-free bench away from drafts and connect it to a 230 V AC / 50 Hz supply; power ON and allow the EMFC weighing cell and halogen lamp to stabilize for at least 30 minutes.
Ensure the Ø 95 mm sample pan and reflector are clean and dry, then press the 'TARE' button to zero the empty pan.

Press the 'MENU' key to enter method selection, press the 'SET' button once, use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to choose the required method ID (1-40) for the sample, then press 'SET' again to lock the method.

Press the 'SET' button once to enter drying temperature setup; use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter (e.g., 105 °C for general moisture or 130 °C for plastics); press 'SET' again to lock the value.
Select the drying profile (Standard, Gentle, Rapid, Steps, or High Temperature) and the auto switch-off criterion (e.g., weight-loss per time or %/time) using the SET and arrow keys.
Place a clean aluminum sample pan on the internal weighing fork, close the lid, and press 'TARE' to zero the pan weight.
Spread 3–5 g of homogeneous sample uniformly across the pan as a thin layer to ensure even halogen exposure; avoid clumping and sample stacking.
Close the heating chamber lid and press the 'START' button; monitor the real-time moisture curve on the graphical LCD without opening the lid during drying.

When the selected auto switch-off criterion is reached, the analyzer will stop heating; allow the chamber to cool briefly, then record the displayed moisture content, dry solids mass, time, and user ID.
Remove the pan, discard or retrieve the dried residue, clean the pan and reflector with a soft brush or lint-free cloth, and transfer data via RS232/USB/PS2 if GLP/GMP log retention is required.

CAUTION: The halogen heating chamber and sample pan may reach 175 °C (or up to 250 °C with thermal upgrades); never open the lid during or immediately after heating, and do not test flammable, explosive, highly volatile, or strong-acid samples that can ignite or release corrosive fumes.
